address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x29`.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#configuration-variables)*

allow_multiple_touches.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to allow multitouch. Defaults to off.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Set the ID of this sensor.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#configuration-variables)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: Set the pin that is used to reset the CAP1188 board on boot.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#configuration-variables)*

touch_threshold.docs:
**int**: The touch threshold for all channels. This defines the sensitivity for touch detection.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#configuration-variables)*

cap1188_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the CAP1188 defined above. Useful for multiple CAP1188's on the I²C bus.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#binary-sensor)*

channel.docs:
**int**: The channel number the CAP1188 the touchkey is connected to.

*See also: [CAP1188 Capacitive Touch Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/cap1188#binary-sensor)*
